features.name: debt_to_age_ratio
features.description: The ratio of the total credit amount to the applicant's age. Aims to capture the loan burden relative to the applicant's life stage.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a scale-invariant measure of financial burden, helping k-NN to group individuals with similar debt profiles relative to their age.

features.name: monthly_payment_proxy
features.description: An estimate of the monthly payment, calculated as the total credit amount divided by the loan duration in months.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a key feature for assessing affordability. Points with similar monthly payments will be closer in the feature space, improving neighborhood quality.

features.name: normalized_age
features.description: Applicant's age, min-max scaled to a [0, 1] range based on the training set's min and max age.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures the age feature is on a comparable scale to other features, preventing it from dominating distance calculations in the k-NN model.

features.name: normalized_credit_amount
features.description: Credit amount, min-max scaled to a [0, 1] range based on the training set's min and max credit amount.
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes the scale of the credit amount, which has a large range, to improve the performance of distance-based algorithms like k-NN.

features.name: high_value_loan_indicator
features.description: A binary flag indicating if the credit amount is significantly large, defined as being greater than one standard deviation above the mean from the training set (approx. 3778 + 3166 = 6944).
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a clear partition in the feature space between high-value and standard loans, which can help define more distinct and meaningful neighborhoods for the k-NN algorithm.

features.name: long_term_loan_indicator
features.description: A binary flag for loans with a long duration, defined as being greater than one standard deviation above the mean from the training set (approx. 22 + 13 = 35).
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates applicants by loan term commitment, potentially improving the geometry of the feature space for identifying groups with different long-term risk profiles.

features.name: financial_stability_score
features.description: A composite score from 0 to 11 reflecting financial health. Higher scores indicate greater stability. Score is based on checking status (0-3), savings status (0-4), and employment duration (0-4).
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates several categorical features into a single, ordered dimension of financial stability. This simplifies the feature space and helps k-NN find neighbors with similar financial backgrounds.

features.name: credit_history_quality_score
features.description: An ordinal score from 1 to 4 representing the quality of past credit behavior, derived from the 'credit_history' category. Higher scores indicate better history (e.g., 4 for 'all paid', 1 for 'critical').
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts a critical categorical feature into a meaningful ordinal scale, allowing the distance metric to correctly interpret degrees of creditworthiness.

features.name: has_real_estate
features.description: A binary indicator (0 or 1) for whether the applicant owns real estate, based on the 'property_magnitude' feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a strong binary signal for a significant asset, which can create a clear and useful separation in the feature space for the k-NN model to leverage.

features.name: is_unemployed_or_unskilled
features.description: Binary indicator for applicants who are either 'unemployed' (from 'employment') or have an 'unskilled' job type (from 'job').
features.expected_model_benefit: Identifies a specific sub-population that may share similar characteristics, helping to form a distinct cluster and improving the definition of local neighborhoods.

features.name: single_male_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for applicants whose personal status is 'male single', a large demographic group in the dataset.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures a large, distinct demographic segment. This binary split can help the k-NN model form more homogeneous neighborhoods based on personal status.

features.name: loan_purpose_granularity
features.description: A score representing the specificity and potential collateral of the loan purpose. High-ticket, tangible items (car, radio/tv, furniture) get a high score (2), business/education a medium score (1), and others/repairs a low score (0).
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups loan purposes into a simplified ordinal feature, allowing the distance metric to capture similarity between purposes more effectively than one-hot encoding would.
